statement.name: GetResourceInstance
statement.sql: SELECT ri.ResourceIdentifierId as 'Id' , ri.SourceId as 'ResourceValue' , ri.ResourceTrackingNo as 'ResourceTrackingNo' , ri.Name as 'Name' , ri.Description as 'Description' , ri.ResourceTypeCode as 'ResourceTypeCode' , ri.CreatorId as 'CreatorId' , ri.CreatedDate as 'CreatedDate' , ri.LastUpdateId as 'LastUpdateId' , ri.LastUpdateDate as 'LastUpdateDate' , lr.LongDisplayValue as 'ResourceDescription' , ri.AttributesXml as AttributesXml FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri INNER JOIN LookupResourceType lr on lr.LookupCode = ri.ResourceTypeCode

statement.name: GetResourceLinks
statement.sql:
SELECT ri.ResourceIdentifierId as 'Id' ,ri.SourceId as 'ResourceValue' ,ri.ResourceTrackingNo as 'ResourceTrackingNo' ,ri.Name as 'Name' ,ri.Description as 'Description' ,ri.ResourceTypeCode as 'ResourceTypeCode' ,ri.CreatorId as 'CreatorId' ,ri.CreatedDate as 'CreatedDate' ,ri.LastUpdateId as 'LastUpdateId' ,ri.LastUpdateDate as 'LastUpdateDate' ,lr.LongDisplayValue as 'ResourceDescription' ,ri.AttributesXml as AttributesXml FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri INNER JOIN LookupResourceType lr on lr.LookupCode = ri.ResourceTypeCode
DECLARE @Resources TABLE ( Id uniqueidentifier ) insert into @Resources SELECT ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS 'Id'
FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri INNER JOIN LookupResourceType lr ON lr.LookupCode = ri.ResourceTypeCode
select * from PFM_Resource_Relationship rel join @Resources ri ON (rel.ResourceIdentifierId = ri.Id OR rel.ChildResourceIdentifierId = ri.Id)
SELECT ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS 'Id', ri.SourceId AS 'ResourceValue', ri.ResourceTrackingNo AS 'ResourceTrackingNo', ri.Name AS 'Name', ri.Description AS 'Description', ri.ResourceTypeCode AS 'ResourceTypeCode', ri.CreatorId AS 'CreatorId', ri.CreatedDate AS 'CreatedDate', ri.LastUpdateId AS 'LastUpdateId', ri.LastUpdateDate AS 'LastUpdateDate', lr.LongDisplayValue AS 'ResourceDescription' ,ri.AttributesXml as AttributesXml FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri INNER JOIN LookupResourceType lr ON lr.LookupCode = ri.ResourceTypeCode
JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rel ON (rel.ResourceIdentifierId = ri.ResourceIdentifierId OR rel.ChildResourceIdentifierId = ri.ResourceIdentifierId) AND join @Resources r on ((Id = rel.ResourceIdentifierId) OR (Id = rel.ChildResourceIdentifierId)) and ID <> ri.ResourceIdentifierId

statement.name: GetChildren
statement.sql:
; WITH RecursiveResourceHierarchy( [Level],Id, ResourceValue, ResourceTypeCode, ResourceTrackingNo, Name, Description, ParentId, ParentResourceValue, ParentResourceTrackingNo, ParentName,ParentDescription ) AS (
SELECT 1 [Level], rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId AS Id, ric.SourceId as ResourceValue, ric.ResourceTypeCode ResourceTypeCode , ric.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo, ric.Name as Name, ric.Description as Description, ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS ParentId, ri.SourceId as ParentResourceValue, ri.ResourceTrackingNo as ParentResourceTrackingNo, ri.Name as ParentName, ri.Description AS ParentDescription FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rr ON rr.ResourceIdentifierId = ri.ResourceIdentifierId JOIN PFM_Resource_Instance ric ON ric.ResourceIdentifierId = rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId
rr.RelationShipCategoryTypeCode in (1,3)
UNION ALL
SELECT Level + 1 [Level], rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId AS Id, ric.SourceId as ResourceValue, ric.ResourceTypeCode ResourceTypeCode , ric.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo, ric.Name as Name, ric.Description as Description, ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS ParentId, ri.SourceId as ParentResourceValue, ri.ResourceTrackingNo as ParentResourceTrackingNo, ri.Name as ParentName, ri.Description AS ParentDescription FROM RecursiveResourceHierarchy rh JOIN PFM_Resource_Instance ri ON ri.ResourceIdentifierId = rh.Id JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rr ON rh.Id = rr.ResourceIdentifierId JOIN PFM_Resource_Instance ric ON ric.ResourceIdentifierId = rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId
rr.RelationShipCategoryTypeCode in (1,3)
)
SELECT * FROM RecursiveResourceHierarchy

statement.name: GetParents
statement.sql:
; WITH RecursiveResourceHierarchy( [Level],Id, ResourceValue, ResourceTypeCode, ResourceTrackingNo, Name, Description --ParentId, ParentResourceValue, ParentResourceTypeCode,ParentResourceTrackingNo, ParentName,ParentDescription ) AS (
SELECT 0 as [Level], ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS Id, ri.SourceId as ResourceValue, ri.ResourceTypeCode, ri.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo, ri.Name as Name, ri.Description AS Description
FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rr ON rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId = ri.ResourceIdentifierId
rr.RelationShipCategoryTypeCode in (1,3)
UNION ALL
SELECT level + 1 [Level], rp.ResourceIdentifierId AS Id, rp.SourceId as ResourceValue, rp.ResourceTypeCode, rp.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo, rp.Name as Name, rp.Description AS Description FROM RecursiveResourceHierarchy rh JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rr ON rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId = rh.Id join PFM_Resource_Instance rp on rr.ResourceIdentifierId = rp.ResourceIdentifierId
rr.RelationShipCategoryTypeCode in (1,3)
)
SELECT rh.Level, rh.Id, rh.ResourceValue, rh.ResourceTypeCode, rh.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo, rh.Name as Name, rh.Description AS Description, rp.ResourceIdentifierId AS ParentId, rp.SourceId as ParentResourceValue, rp.ResourceTypeCode as ParentResourceTypeCode, rp.ResourceTrackingNo as ParentResourceTrackingNo, rp.Name as ParentName, rp.Description AS ParentDescription into #temp FROM RecursiveResourceHierarchy rh left JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rr ON rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId = rh.Id left join PFM_Resource_Instance rp on rr.ResourceIdentifierId = rp.ResourceIdentifierId
SELECT * FROM #temp union ALL
SELECT , rp.ResourceIdentifierId, rp.SourceId as ResourceValue, rp.ResourceTypeCode, rp.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo, rp.Name as Name, rp.Description AS Description, null AS ParentId, null as ParentResourceValue, null as ParentResourceTypeCode, null as ParentResourceTrackingNo, null as ParentName, null AS ParentDescription FROM #temp rh join PFM_Resource_Instance rp ON rh.parentId = rp.ResourceIdentifierId WHERE rh.ParentId not in (SELECT ID from #temp) and NOT IN (SELECT LEVEL FROM #TEMP) drop table #temp;

statement.name: GetResourceLinkList
statement.sql: SELECT distinct ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS 'Id', ri.SourceId AS 'ResourceValue', ri.ResourceTrackingNo AS 'ResourceTrackingNo', ri.Name AS 'Name', ri.Description AS 'Description', ri.ResourceTypeCode AS 'ResourceTypeCode', ri.CreatorId AS 'CreatorId', ri.CreatedDate AS 'CreatedDate', ri.LastUpdateId AS 'LastUpdateId', ri.LastUpdateDate AS 'LastUpdateDate', lr.LongDisplayValue AS 'ResourceDescription' FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri INNER JOIN LookupResourceType lr ON lr.LookupCode = ri.ResourceTypeCode JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rel ON (rel.ResourceIdentifierId = ri.ResourceIdentifierId OR rel.ChildResourceIdentifierId = ri.ResourceIdentifierId) AND join PFM_Resource_Instance r on (r.ResourceIdentifierId = rel.ResourceIdentifierId OR r.ResourceIdentifierId = rel.ChildResourceIdentifierId) and r.ResourceIdentifierId <> ri.ResourceIdentifierId

statement.name: GetRecursivelyRelatedResources
statement.sql:
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #temp
;WITH RecursiveParentHierarchy( [Level],Id, PathIdentifier) AS ( SELECT 0 as [Level] , ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS Id , cast(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ri.ResourceIdentifierId) as varchar(max)) as PathIdentifier FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri
UNION ALL
SELECT level + 1 [Level] , ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS Id , rh.PathIdentifier + '-' + cast(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ri.ResourceIdentifierId) as varchar(max)) as PathIdentifier FROM RecursiveParentHierarchy rh JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rr ON rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId = rh.Id join PFM_Resource_Instance ri on rr.ResourceIdentifierId = ri.ResourceIdentifierId
)
select * into #temp from ( select top 1000 * , Case WHEN Level >= ISNULL(LEAD(level) OVER (ORDER BY PathIdentifier), -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END IsFirst from RecursiveParentHierarchy order by PathIdentifier ) t where t.IsFirst= 1
;WITH RecursiveChildHierarchy( [Level], ParentId,Id, ResourceValue, ResourceTypeCode, ResourceTrackingNo, Name, Description, AttributesXml, CreatorId, CreatedDate, LastUpdateId, LastUpdateDate) AS ( SELECT 0 [Level] , cast(NULL as uniqueidentifier ) as ParentId , ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS Id , ri.SourceId as ResourceValue , ri.ResourceTypeCode ResourceTypeCode , ri.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo , ri.Name as Name , ri.Description as Description , ri.AttributesXml , ri.CreatorId as 'CreatorId' , ri.CreatedDate as 'CreatedDate' , ri.LastUpdateId as 'LastUpdateId' , ri.LastUpdateDate as 'LastUpdateDate' FROM PFM_Resource_Instance ri Join #temp temp on temp.Id = ri.ResourceIdentifierId
UNION ALL
SELECT Level + 1 [Level] , rr.ResourceIdentifierId as ParentId , ri.ResourceIdentifierId AS Id , ri.SourceId as ResourceValue , ri.ResourceTypeCode ResourceTypeCode , ri.ResourceTrackingNo as ResourceTrackingNo , ri.Name as Name , ri.Description as Description , ri.AttributesXml , ri.CreatorId as 'CreatorId' , ri.CreatedDate as 'CreatedDate' , ri.LastUpdateId as 'LastUpdateId' , ri.LastUpdateDate as 'LastUpdateDate' FROM RecursiveChildHierarchy rh JOIN PFM_Resource_Relationship rr ON rh.Id = rr.ResourceIdentifierId JOIN PFM_Resource_Instance ri ON ri.ResourceIdentifierId = rr.ChildResourceIdentifierId
)
SELECT * FROM RecursiveChildHierarchy order by ResourceValue OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
